title: Workflow Group Details — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: Which chain a workflow group uses for one kind of request. Within the group the most specific row wins: type with sub-type and custom sub-type, then type with sub-type, then the row for the type alone. If the group has no match, the transaction type's default chain is used. A request type can be given to only one chain per group.

fields.label: RequestMaster
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Request Master master data.
fields.html: What it is. The chain to use.

fields.label: RequestType
fields.html:
What it is. The kind of request.

Example. Leave request

fields.label: RequestSubType
fields.html:
What it is. Narrows the row to one sub-type, such as one leave type.

Example. Annual leave

fields.label: CustomSubType
fields.html:
What it is. Narrows the row further.

Why it matters. Requests are routed without a custom sub-type at present, so this does not narrow anything: a row with a sub-type is matched on the sub-type alone, and a row with only this filled in is never chosen.
